postings.title: Account Executive
postings.description:
What we do at Detectify

We’re Detectify, and we’re not your average cybersecurity company. We’re a team obsessed with building cutting-edge tech that actually makes a difference in making the internet a safer place. We’re talking about real-life hackers who know their stuff—you’ll learn from the best and join a team that combines human ingenuity with automation to streamline asset discovery and vulnerability assessments.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a relentless, quota-crushing sales professional to join us in the fight to secure the digital world. If you are a strategic closer who thrives in high-growth startup environments and leverages modern sales methodologies to win, this is your chance to build a massive pipeline and accelerate your career.

The Team

Our Sales team consists of driven and passionate colleages who work with enterprise and mid-market customers from a wide range of industries and from all around the world. We're focused on understanding customer needs and ensuring a smooth, consultative sales process. As part of this high-performing team, you'll collaborate with colleagues who value excellence, continuous improvement, and making a real impact in the cybersecurity space.

What you'll get to do

- Own the Engine: You’ll manage all phases from prospecting and lead generation through qualification, discovery, demonstration, negotiation, and closing

- Drive the Bottom Line: Successfully close net-new business across global enterprise and mid-market segments, ensuring consistent progress toward aggressive quarterly and annual targets.

- Act as a Trusted Advisor: Cultivate lasting relationships with global prospects, guiding them through their most critical application security challenges.

- Master the Process: Build, forecast, and rigorously manage your pipeline while maintaining impeccable records in our CRM.

- Become an Industry Expert: Keep a pulse on the cybersecurity landscape, competitive threats, customer challenges and industry trends to continuously sharpen your pitch.

- Collaborate to Win: Partner seamlessly with marketing, product, and customer success teams to ensure a flawless customer journey from prospect to champion.

Who you are

- A Proven Closer: 2+ years of complex B2B Tech sales experience (cybersecurity experience is a massive plus). You have a track record of owning the entire cycle and consistently crushing quota.

- A Strategic Operator: You know how to leverage MEDDPICC (or similar) to rigorously qualify deals, navigate complex buying committees, and drive predictable revenue

- A Forward-Thinker: You actively leverage modern AI tools to optimize your workflow, automate prospect research, and maximize your daily selling time.

- An Entrepreneurial Builder: You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth startup environments. You are highly proactive, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently.

- A Clear Communicator: You possess exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English (additional European languages are a strong advantage).

- A Tech-Savvy Pro: You navigate Salesforce (or similar CRMs) with ease to manage your pipeline.

- A Healthy Competitor: You are driven by targets, hungry for success, and constantly looking for ways to elevate your sales skills and product knowledge.

Flexible work

This is a hybrid role based out of our Stockholm office, located in Gamla stan, where we love to collaborate in person a few days a week.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about security!

We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination, where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work.

English is our corporate language, so please send us your CV and cover letter in English.

Please note that we are unable to offer relocation assistance for this position.

Go hack yourself!

postings.title: Cyber Security Solutions Engineer
postings.description:
What we do at Detectify

We're Detectify, a cybersecurity company obsessed with making the internet safer. We’re a team motivated by building cutting-edge tech that makes a difference. We’re talking about real-life hackers who know their stuff. You’ll learn from the best and join a team that combines human ingenuity with automation to streamline attack surface discovery and vulnerability assessments. We also launch newly architected tools for deeper agentic integrations. The new user is not a human but an agent.

We're looking for a Solution Engineer who’d like to live at the intersection of cybersecurity, customer interaction, problem-solving, and hands-on engineering.

The problem you will be solving

At Detectify, we help security teams scale their application security program to their full external attack surface, even beyond what they know they have today. We do this with a strong foundation in hacker methodologies.

Buyers of security tools need more than a feature checklist. They need proof that a solution fits their environment, integrates into workflows, and delivers measurable risk reduction. As a Cyber Security Solutions Engineer, you close that gap by helping prospects see how Detectify solves their specific security challenges during evaluation. You also help customers turn findings into prioritized action, adoption, and demonstrable ROI after the sale. You're the technical link connecting a security concern to a business outcome and a commercial partner to your Account Executive and Customer Success Manager.

What you will be doing

- Run technical evaluations and PoCs - from discovery and scoping to demos, finding validation, and wrap-up reports that map results to the customer's success criteria.

- Act as a trusted security advisor to prospects and customers, translating vulnerability findings and attack surface insights into business risk and helping teams prioritize and remediate what matters most.

- Guide customers on integrating Detectify into their SDLC/DevSecOps workflows and monitor adoption after go-live.

- Work in an AI native context by using AI tools to speed up account research, demo personalization, content creation, and build lightweight automations to streamline recurring workflows. You will also help prospects and customers adopt Detectify's agentic AI security solutions successfully.

- Lead QBRs and (at senior level) executive business reviews, using data-driven storytelling to show security posture improvements and ROI.

- Build and maintain reusable technical assets: demo environments, PoC playbooks, enablement content, and async video.

- Stay current on CVEs, attack techniques, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, PCI DSS, and others), and translate that expertise into customer-facing narratives.

- Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Product, Security Research, and Support on customer health, feedback, and escalations - and feed market/competitive insights back into go-to-market.

Who you are

We believe you are entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable working independently while knowing when to leverage team resources. You thrive in high-growth, fast-paced startup environments where adaptability and initiative are essential, and you're motivated by targets and competitive in a healthy way. To be successful in this role we see that you are committed to constantly improving your commercial and interpersonal skills, cyber skills, approach, and product knowledge.

We Think You Have

- Either
- a background in cybersecurity with strong interpersonal skills, or
- 2+ years of experience in Tech/SaaS as a solution or sales engineer, preferably in B2B cyber security solutions with experience selling technical or complex IT solutions that require consultative skills.

- Strong verbal and written communication in English; additional European languages are a plus!

- Preference in utilising modern AI tools to optimize the sales cycle, maximize daily productivity, and enhance prospect research.

Why this is interesting

You'll work at the cutting edge of cybersecurity and AI, helping shape how Detectify's agentic solutions are adopted by security teams worldwide. Not just selling a product, but solving real problems alongside hackers and engineers who live and breathe this stuff. It's a rare chance to grow both your technical depth and commercial edge while helping define what security looks like in an AI-native world.

Hybrid work

This position is for the Stockholm office. We offer hybrid working, with access to our office in central Stockholm and would like to see you at the office at least 3 days per week.

So, what do you think? We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about security! Go hack yourself!

postings.title: Security Research - LIA/Internship (Unpaid)
postings.description:
What we do at Detectify

We’re Detectify, and we’re not your average cybersecurity company. We’re a team obsessed with building cutting-edge tech that actually makes a difference in making the internet a safer place. We’re talking about real-life hackers who know their stuff—you’ll learn from the best and join a team that combines human ingenuity with automation to streamline asset discovery and vulnerability assessments.

The Vulnerability Assessment Research team

This team is currently composed of security researchers focused on making sure that the members of Detectify Crowdsource - our network of ethical hackers - are engaged and enjoying the best possible experience when collaborating with Detectify.

When our hackers submit a vulnerability through our Crowdsource platform, our team builds a module for it and adds it to the Detectify service. Once a vulnerability is reported to us, it becomes a security test which is then made available to all our customers - this is how Detectify combines automation and crowdsourcing.

These tests come in various unique flavors and are driven by crowdsourced security knowledge. We in the Vulnerability Assessment Research team are responsible for validating, configuring, and executing such tests on our customers’ web applications.

We aim for the best possible scanning performance with comprehensive coverage of possible security issues, optimizing for flow, fast feedback, and quality. We follow lean and DevOps concepts, aiming to be innovative and helpful, and to have a strong sense of ownership of all the things we build.

What you'll get to do

As a Security Researcher, your main responsibility will be to validate and implement proof of concepts, uploaded by our Crowdsource and internal researchers, into our scanners. This is a great opportunity to boost your knowledge around hacking and vulnerabilities.

Other responsibilities include:

- Communicate with our internal security researchers in order to gather all necessary information to understand the submitted vulnerabilities.

- Develop modules from vulnerability reports using a JSON-based DSL or Go.

- Perform code reviews to ensure accuracy and reduce false positives.

- Consistently review behavior of implemented modules to identify false positives or negatives.

- Work with continuous automation of module development.

Who you are

We believe that you are a student and want to do your LIA (work placement) with us here at Detectify for a period of 6 months. You are a highly versatile and self-motivated individual who can create and drive change. You are involved with the security community and understand how vulnerabilities work. You have a strong interest in internet security and you want to engage with an international network of security researchers. Ideally, you have some hands-on experience with bug bounties, CTFs (Capture the Flag), or similar.
